# GitHub Workflow Governance

This directory contains reusable GitHub workflow skeletons for the StarOne Galaxy ecosystem.

## Workflow Baseline

| Workflow                | Purpose                         |
| ----------------------- | ------------------------------- |
| markdown-validation.yml | Markdown lint validation        |
| governance-check.yml    | Governance structure validation |
| pr-validation.yml       | PR governance enforcement       |
| naming-validation.yml   | Naming standards validation     |

## Future Expansion

Future enhancements will include:

- Architecture validation
- Mermaid diagram linting
- Security scanning
- Dependency governance
- SBOM validation
- Container scanning
- Kubernetes manifest validation
- OpenAPI governance checks
